name: 废土矿区第三版统一资产
objective: 使用已配置的Meshy生产一致的原创美式漫画工业废土PBR模型。枪械适合近距离VR观察，机械敌人具备清晰关节边界。模型以粗重墨线、手绘排线、分区明暗、锈橙/沙岩/深铁灰色块统一，供Kotlin ECS场景运行时组装；天空、灯光、粒子、动画和地图由应用侧制作。

subjects.generationPrompt: Isolated original industrial wasteland automatic rifle, complete unobstructed product. Long machined barrel with vented heat shield, angular heavy steel receiver, optical iron sight, ergonomic pistol grip, open trigger guard with trigger, curved detachable magazine, exposed charging bolt, shoulder stock. Separate readable mechanical part boundaries, horizontal barrel, no hands, no stand, no scenery.

composition.description: 资产库分组展示，每个独立原型完整可检视，具有统一材质细节密度；运行时实际地图约80x100米，四区布局另由Kotlin管理。原型不相互遮挡。HeroRifle、ChargerRobot、SandstoneRock作为首批风格样板，其余资产延续相同标准。
